name: saas-platform/packages
description: Private Satis repository for SaaS Platform internal modules — Phase 8.3a

_setup.step_1: Set GitHub Secret SATIS_DEPLOY_KEY (SSH deploy key for packages server)
_setup.step_2: Replace YOUR_ORG with actual GitHub org name in repositories[0].url
_setup.step_3: Replace homepage with actual packages server domain
_setup.step_4: Push to main → GitHub Actions builds Satis index and deploys to server
_setup.step_5: Add Satis repo to customer-site: composer config repositories.saas-packages '{"type":"composer","url":"https://packages.safhenokhost.ir"}'
_setup.local_dev: Path repositories in composer.json override Satis — local dev unaffected
